package main import "github.com/vuka-lang/ui/v2" // Table keeps its page and sort in the URL, and reads its route's {id}. type Table struct { ui.Live Title string Sort string @ui.URL("sort") page int @ui.URL("page").Default(1) id int64 @ui.URL } func (t *Table) Next() { t.page++ }

{Title} {id}: page {page}, sort {Sort}
